videos.title: GFL Season 5 Punishments
videos.description: The offseason has come to a close, and with the draft just days away the Punishment Czar wanted to take some time to outline the weekly punishments for this upcoming season.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 2025 Finale
videos.description: Sad to see it come but glad it happened. The GFL 2025 comes to a close and it has been a wild ride. I'd like to be the first to thank you all for riding it with us.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 16 2025
videos.description: IT IS THE SEMI-FINALS but there is nothing SEMI about this episode of B&C. We dive full on into the matchups and provide you with the analysis you DESPRATLEY need for this weeks GFL matchups.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 15 2025
videos.description: THE PLAYOFFS ARE HERE! We have finally begun the GFL postseason! THIS is why we play the game, THIS is what we have been waiting for. 6 managers and only 1 title. Not to mention 50 dogs on the line for the losers locked in our losers bracket. Join the ball, the commissioner, and our punishment czar as we break down this coming week.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 14 2025
videos.description: THE BIGGEST WEEK IN GFL HISTORY IS HERE!!! 5 managers and only 3 playoff spots remain. Must win games, should win games, and impossible to win games are all ahead. However, if we have learned anything so far, it's that nothing is impossible in this great league of ours.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 13 2025
videos.description: Happy Thanksgiving from your favorite duo, we know you're thankful for us so no need to put it down in the comments (unless you want to). Come spend the holiday with us as the chain joins the ball and a special guest star for this bare bones episode of the best sports show on the web

videos.title: Ball and Chain 12 2025
videos.description: WHAT A HUMONGOUS WEEK, Rivalry week and the Coaching metric all in one episode. LUCKY YOU!

videos.title: Ball and Chain 11 2025
videos.description: THE WEEK BEFORE RIVALRY WEEK, THE CALM BEFORE THE STORM THAT ISNT THAT CALM. THE STORM IS THE FLORIDA MAN AND THE FLORIDA MAN IS A HURRICAINE. OH YEA BABY

videos.title: Ball and Chain 10 2025
videos.description: WE ARE BACK YET AGAIN, JUST LIKE CLOCKWORK. The silly willies are back being sillier and wilier than ever before. We have some hot takes and an even hotter set of matchups to review. TUNE TF IN

videos.title: Ball and Chain 9 2025
videos.description: HAPPY HALLOWEEN from the scariest duo to hit the scene since the mulligans and a box of fresh crispy creme donuts. Our yearly Halloween special is finally here and it may be one of our best yet.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 8 2025
videos.description: We are OFFICIALLY halfway through the regular season over here at the GFL and this season has been nothing short of stupendous, shocking, and downright silly. The ball and also the chain engage in one of their most entertaining episodes yet.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 7 2025
videos.description: This one is JAM PACKED with segments so I hope you all like jam. Headlines, a secret segment, the punishment czar, a wheel spin, and as always your two favorite co hosts.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 6 2025
videos.description: MR COMMISSIONER HOW DO YOU DO. Tune in to this one to get the Ball and Chain's playoff predictions and an update on the state of the league from everyone's favorite politician.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 5 2025
videos.description: WE got a BIG guest for you today after some HUGE trades that have shaken the very foundation of our generic fantasy football league. The league members have been CLAMORING for this episode and they will not be disappointed!
